blocks.x: Failure modes & the guards we ship
Failure modes we design against, with the guard shipped for each:

items: Key fragility
Key fragility, the classic killer; here root keys live in HSMs under dual control with ceremony logs; rotation is rehearsed, not documented
Ledger worship
Ledger worship, the classic killer; here a chain only helps where counterparties dispute truth; workflows that already trust one database stay on one database
On-chain PII
On-chain PII — personal data never touches the ledger; only salted hashes and pointers are anchored
